findings.summary: /v1/voice endpoints raise unhandled binascii.Error (HTTP 500) on malformed base64 payload instead of 400/422
findings.expected: Safe invariant: no 500 on client input; malformed base64 audio must fail closed with HTTP 400 or 422 (piece stabilise-and-auth §6.9, §2.2)
findings.actual: HTTP 500 Internal Server Error due to unhandled binascii.Error in base64.b64decode
findings.resolution: Fixed: _decode_audio uses strict base64 (validate=True) on /v1/voice/transcribe and /v1/voice/turn -> 422 INVALID_AUDIO_BASE64. Decision: line-wrapped (MIME) base64 is rejected too; JSON clients send unwrapped base64.

findings.summary: /v1/schema/synthesize raises unhandled ValueError (HTTP 500) on invalid domain enum value instead of 422/400
findings.expected: Safe invariant: no 500 on client input; invalid domain string must be validated and rejected with HTTP 422 or 400 (piece stabilise-and-auth §6.9, §2.2)
findings.actual: HTTP 500 Internal Server Error due to unhandled ValueError: 'INVALID_DOMAIN' is not a valid EntityType
findings.resolution: Fixed: _entity_type on /v1/schema/synthesize and /synthesize/agentic -> 422 INVALID_DOMAIN; case-insensitive domain still accepted (boundary test).

findings.summary: GET /v1/schema/mappings/{vendor}/{entity_type} raises unhandled MappingGovernanceError (HTTP 500) when vendor/entity contains ':' instead of 400/404
findings.expected: Safe invariant: no 500 on client input; keys with colon must return client error HTTP 400 or 404 (piece piece-g decision G4a, stabilise-and-auth §6.9)
findings.actual: HTTP 500 Internal Server Error due to unhandled MappingGovernanceError: INVALID_KEY
findings.resolution: Fixed: GET /v1/schema/mappings/{vendor}/{entity_type} maps MappingGovernanceError INVALID_KEY -> 400 {error: INVALID_KEY}.
